newsitem.title: USA: Iomega says faces consumer class action.
newsitem.headline: Iomega says faces consumer class action.

text.p: Iomega Corp said it confirmed that it was served on July 21 with a complaint brought on behalf of a class of consumers.
The suit was filed in the Delaware Court of Chancery on July 16 and alleges violations of the Magnuson-Moss Consumer Products Warranties Act and the Delaware Consumer Fraud Act, the company said.

The claimed violations were based on alleged breaches of Iomega's Zip, Jaz and Ditto product warranties and on the company's technical support charges and practices, a news release issued by Iomega said.
The complaint seeks injunctive relief, restitution for amounts paid by consumers for certain calls to Iomega's technical support line and reasonable legal fees, the release said.
Iomega said it is in the process of investigating and evaluating the claims stated in the complaint.
